task_definition.task_description: I need an alternative to the black Sony XM5 in electronics, then prepare an invoice request for 1 item for alice@company.com using PayPal, sort the recommended item options in descending order, and after that check whether NASDAQ is open and get the USD to EUR exchange rate. Then go ahead and place the order for the best recommendation for 1 unit.
